rows.rootCause: Completeness is taken from the native recorder's termination only; upload-side loss is not an input to completeness, and the server cannot see segments that were never declared.
rows.decision: Continuity manifest V2: REQUIRED recordedSegmentCount, partIndex===sequence, duplicate-sequence refusal, head/tail coverage for COMPLETE, SEGMENT_UPLOAD_LOST/SEGMENT_WRITE_FAILED/BROADCAST_PAUSED limitations that forbid COMPLETE, gaps only as INTERRUPTED+SEGMENT_UPLOAD_LOST. Server seal restructured per lead review into three steps, no transaction open while hashing (ET-ACQ-04): (A) short tx under the capture-session advisory lock loads the session + declarations, runs the mode planner against that exact snapshot (declared SCREEN_SEGMENT parts are the authoritative expected set; manifest part must follow them), passes governance, and CLAIMS the session (status stays ACTIVE, endReason = CAPTURE_SEAL_CLAIM.endReason 'SEAL_IN_PROGRESS', claim timestamp = updatedAt; lease 10 min, in packages/shared capture-limits.ts); (B) outside any transaction: manifest classing, manifest facts, storage size checks, completeEvidence with the claimed declaration snapshot as expectedSha256ByPartIndex (refuses any part set differing from the plan); (C) short tx under the lock binds claim -> BOUND with final endReason + case link in one commit. While a claim is live, declarations, reserve, discard and other seals answer SESSION_BUSY (409, retryable); a failed non-terminal hash releases the claim back to ACTIVE; a terminal digest refusal interrupts; a stale claim is reclaimed by the next seal, cleared by a declaration, and released by the capture reaper (which never expires a session under a live claim). The client reconciles recorded vs declared via the pure src/continuous-manifest.ts.

rows.rootCause: Finalize treated as one-shot; draft transition bound to create instead of seal.
rows.decision: [A] Server half: POST /v1/evidence with a captureSessionId BINDS the draft (finalizedEvidenceId) but leaves it DRAFT; completeEvidence moves bound DRAFTs to FINALIZED inside the sealing transaction. A retried create for the same draft returns 200 {id (same record), resumed:true, parts:[{partIndex, originalFileName, mimeType, sizeBytes}]} while the record is unsealed, live and not an expired reservation — no second record. Lane W must keep evidenceId, skip uploaded part indexes and reset per-item state in catch. [W] Client half of resumable Finish & Sign at the canonical orchestrator (useCaptureSessionOrchestration). A per-staged-set reservation keeps the evidenceId: a retry after a part failure reuses the SAME record (no second POST /v1/evidence), skips already-uploaded items, re-presigns only missing parts (parts route is RETURN_EXISTING per partIndex), and a failed /complete retries only /complete; the reservation is abandoned if items are removed/reordered so a part index is never re-bound to another file. The catch now resets every item's uploading/progress and marks the failing item with a safe error. Across a reload the server is the authority: lane A's POST /v1/evidence returns the draft's reserved unsealed record (resolveResumableDraftRecord, resumed:true) for the same captureSessionId, which the client always sends. No Idempotency-Key header is sent because the API CORS allow-list does not include it (it would break the cross-origin create). Offline: finalize refuses to start (nothing minted) and staged items are kept. LEAD ADJUDICATION: Finish & Sign resumes into the same record (server answers resumed:true with the parts already present; the hook uploads only the missing ones).
